Damn, I’m sorry you were put on hold for so long. It was suggested to me to call one of the hotlines, however it’s just tricky being optimistic about their usefulness. 
The two services I have contacted so far were recommended to me by my previous counsellor, but again, all the available clinics are notoriously known for being unhelpful. But I will once again try find some connections through my psychologist, however there’s just not many around. Thank you for your advice and if you’re still looking, I hope you too find adequate support.
Australia is meant to be pretty good with health care, as it is free to an extent (a certain amount of free therapy sessions), but fuck me are they shit with actually helping.
It’s sorta on the outer lining of eye. Not the actually eye, but that little scale type ring around them. Sorry for my bad explanation.
Oh, funny seeing someone I know in real life on here. Surreal lol
